to.text: one hundred trillion dollars · issued 16 January 2009

overlay_corrections.why: render_ffmpeg draws stat.sub as the hero number and stat.text as the label; the authored fields were swapped, so the date rendered at hero size and ran off-frame (seen in test clip). The full 15-digit figure is visible on the note itself. 'Z$100 TRILLION' still overflowed the hero size in a test clip, so the hero is 'Z$100T' and the label spells it out.
